pages.text: Before entering this dimension, I tried to gather as much information as possible. It wasn't easy, because mostly junk from our world ends up here, but I managed to find some valuable things too. Among them, a square metal box that glowed stood out. Something was written on it, but the label that immediately caught my eye was $(#ff0000)EXIT$().

When I tried to interact with the box, it went dark and the smell of burning filled the air. Perhaps, once in the dimension, I'll be able to find another one or $(#ff0000)create something similar...$()
